extra_vocab.en: in a way that you did not expect
extra_vocab.note: 用來說明事情和預期不同，常見於延誤、費用變動、人事異動的通知。這篇文章談的是不在預期內的扣款，說明「出乎意料的收費」時就可以用 unexpectedly。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: unexpectedly 是副詞，修飾動詞或形容詞（unexpectedly high）；放在名詞前要用形容詞 unexpected（an unexpected charge）。

example.en: The repair costs were unexpectedly high this quarter.
example.zh: 這一季的維修費用高得出乎意料。

example.en: The speaker unexpectedly canceled her visit on Monday morning.
example.zh: 講者星期一早上臨時取消了她的來訪。

example.en: Our shipment was unexpectedly delayed by bad weather.
example.zh: 我們的貨物因為壞天氣而意外延誤。

examples.en: I was unexpectedly charged twice for the same plan.
examples.zh: 我同一個方案出乎意料地被收了兩次費用。

examples.en: The manager unexpectedly left the company at the end of March.
examples.zh: 經理在三月底出乎意料地離開了公司。

examples.en: The meeting ended unexpectedly early, so we went back to work.
examples.zh: 會議意外地提早結束，所以我們回去工作了。

confusable.diff: unexpected 是形容詞，修飾名詞；unexpectedly 是副詞，修飾動詞或形容詞。
confusable.usage: 名詞前面用 unexpected（an unexpected delay），動詞前面用 unexpectedly（was unexpectedly delayed）。

example.en: We received an unexpected call from the client yesterday.
example.zh: 我們昨天接到客戶出乎意料的來電。

similar.diff: suddenly 強調「很突然、很快」；unexpectedly 強調「和預期不同」，不一定是突然發生。

example.en: The power went out suddenly during the presentation.
example.zh: 簡報進行到一半時，電力突然中斷了。

similar.diff: surprisingly 帶有說話者的驚訝語氣；unexpectedly 較中性，用於陳述事實。

example.en: Surprisingly, the new plan was approved without any changes.
example.zh: 令人驚訝的是，新計畫沒有任何更動就通過了。

example.en: The sudden price change was a surprise to everyone.
example.zh: 價格突然改變，讓每個人都很意外。

example.en: We apologize for the delay in your order.
example.zh: 對於您訂單的延誤，我們深感抱歉。

example.en: An emergency meeting will start in ten minutes.
example.zh: 緊急會議十分鐘後開始。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞，expect to V 表示預計會做某事
un-（不）+ expected（被預期的），像 unable、unhappy

extra_vocab.en: an amount of money or an amount of something that you are allowed to have
extra_vocab.note: 指公司或單位給員工的津貼，如住宿津貼、交通津貼，常出現在人事規定與出差情境。這句話的 ineligible 和文章裡 refund request was not eligible 相似，allowance 常搭配「有沒有資格領」的規定。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: allowance 是可數名詞（an allowance / allowances）；接用途用 for（an allowance for meals），接金額用 of（an allowance of $50 a day）。

example.en: Some allowances will be paid together with your monthly salary.
example.zh: 有些津貼會和您的月薪一起發放。

example.en: New employees can apply for a housing allowance in their first month.
example.zh: 新進員工可以在第一個月申請住宿津貼。

example.en: The company gives sales staff a travel allowance every month.
example.zh: 公司每個月都會給業務人員交通津貼。

example.en: The baggage allowance on this flight is twenty kilograms.
example.zh: 這個航班的行李額度是二十公斤。

example.en: Staff on business trips receive a daily allowance for meals.
example.zh: 出差的員工可領取每日餐費津貼。

examples.en: Full-time employees receive a monthly allowance for transportation.
examples.zh: 全職員工每個月會領到交通津貼。

examples.en: Please keep your receipts, because the allowance does not cover hotels.
examples.zh: 請保留收據，因為津貼不包含住宿費。

examples.en: You will pay extra if your bag is over the allowance.
examples.zh: 如果您的行李超過額度，就要額外付費。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音都有點像，但 alliance 是「聯盟、結盟」，和津貼無關。

example.en: The two airlines formed an alliance to share routes.
example.zh: 這兩家航空公司結成聯盟，共享航線。

similar.diff: benefit 指公司提供的整體福利（保險、休假等）；allowance 通常是特定用途的一筆錢。

example.en: Health insurance is one of our main employee benefits.
example.zh: 健康保險是我們主要的員工福利之一。

similar.diff: subsidy 是政府或機構給的補貼，用來降低成本；allowance 多半是公司給員工的津貼。

example.en: The government offers a subsidy for small businesses.
example.zh: 政府為小型企業提供補貼。

example.en: Your salary will be paid on the last day of the month.
example.zh: 您的薪水會在每個月的最後一天發放。

example.en: Every employee received a bonus at the end of the year.
example.zh: 每位員工在年底都領到了獎金。

example.en: Please send your travel expense report by Friday.
example.zh: 請在星期五之前交出您的差旅費用報告。

example.en: Only full-time staff are eligible for this allowance.
example.zh: 只有全職員工才有資格領取這項津貼。

derived.link: 最基礎的動詞，allow + -ance 就是「被允許可以領的東西」，像 importance、attendance

senses.en: money that a company gives you for a special cost, such as travel or housing

example.en: The company pays a meal allowance during business trips.
example.zh: 公司在出差期間會支付餐費津貼。

senses.en: the amount of something that you are allowed to have or use
senses.distinguish: 出現在行李、免稅額或用量的情境，指「最多可以帶或用多少」，而不是一筆錢。

example.en: Each guest has a free baggage allowance of one bag.
example.zh: 每位旅客有一件行李的免費額度。
